title: Known Science and Physical Principles: Planetary Intelligence Grid — Public Edition
g: Planetary Intelligence and Civilization Operating Systems
description: Engineering record for Planetary Intelligence Grid (Planetary Intelligence and Civilization Operating Systems). Sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin.
body:
This record sets out the established scientific foundation: what is known, what the governing principles are, and where settled science ends and open questions begin. It covers Planetary Intelligence Grid — An interconnected network of scientific models, environmental sensors, infrastructure data, and AI systems that helps coordinate complex planetary challenges.

Planetary-scale coordination systems aim to make civilization legible to itself: sensing what is happening, modeling what comes next, and allocating resources against explicit constraints. Pieces exist — disaster early warning, grid balancing, epidemic surveillance — but the integrated "civilization OS" is a proposal, not a product. Honest engineering here means designing for disagreement: multiple models, explicit uncertainty, human decision rights, and resilience when the optimizer is wrong.

Feasibility tier: THEORETICALLY-PLAUSIBLE. No known physical law forbids it, and paper studies or small-scale experiments suggest paths forward, but major engineering barriers stand between concept and reality. Records at this tier are explicit about which barriers are engineering and which would need new science.

The established science behind Planetary Intelligence Grid rests on Systems engineering at planetary scale: sensing, modeling, optimization, and control applied to coupled human-natural systems, with humans in the governance loop. At the theoretically-plausible feasibility tier, the honest statement is this: the governing principles are understood on paper and in small experiments, with major open questions about whether they can be engineered into the described capability.

This is the public-edition record: it documents the publicly known research status of Planetary Intelligence Grid as engineering reference. It claims nothing beyond the evidence, and every speculative element carries its feasibility tier openly — never presented as established fact.
